domains.name: lgrep
domains.purpose: Product-wide lgrep law: the dual-engine contract that pairs semantic retrieval with exact symbol lookup, the retrieval guarantees agents depend on, and decisions that bind every child Domain rather than any single one.

domains.name: Semantic retrieval
domains.purpose: Owns the embedding model contract and vector-space integrity: the Voyage client and its batching and cost accounting, AST-aware chunking, the LanceDB chunk store, and the hybrid semantic search path with its staleness pre-flight.

domains.name: Symbol intelligence
domains.purpose: Owns exact symbol and occurrence lookup: tree-sitter language support, symbol and hierarchy extraction, the on-disk symbol index and its version gates, and the symbol indexing and query tools.

domains.name: Corpus ingestion
domains.purpose: Owns what enters the corpus and when: file discovery, gitignore and lgrepignore rule handling, the background file watcher, and the content-hash change detection both engines consume.

domains.name: Agent surface
domains.purpose: Owns the MCP plane agents call: server bootstrap and lifecycle, the runtime and its cancellation contract, typed tool and response schemas, diagnostics, the command-line entry point, and host installation.

domains.name: Store lifecycle
domains.purpose: Owns durable cache custody across both engines: cache directory layout and repository keying, worktree deduplication, invalidation, orphan and symbol pruning, and the path-confinement, symlink, and grace-window guards those reclamations enforce.
